description: Ability to evaluate options, apply rules with sound discretion, balance stakeholder impacts, and take timely accountable actions.
level_1_description: Understands standard rules and seeks guidance for simple decisions.
level_2_description: Applies established precedents to routine matters independently.
level_3_description: Analyzes complex scenarios, weighs risks and alternatives, and decides effectively in ambiguous situations.
level_4_description: Formulates strategic choices, resolves conflicting inter-departmental priorities, and anticipates long-term impacts.
level_5_description: Shapes institutional governance frameworks and leads systemic decision-making under crisis.

description: Ability to plan, execute, monitor milestones, manage risks, coordinate teams, and deliver public schemes within budget and time.
level_1_description: Tracks assigned tasks and records progress against given timelines.
level_2_description: Coordinates work breakdown schedules and monitors basic team milestones.
level_3_description: Designs project charters, manages critical path dependencies, budgets, and vendor SLAs.
level_4_description: Leads multi-stakeholder government programmes, handles major deviations, and optimizes resource allocations.
level_5_description: Institutes nationwide mission-mode governance frameworks and monitors mega-program portfolios.

description: Commitment to integrity, impartiality, transparency, empathy for citizens, and upholding constitutional values.
level_1_description: Adheres to basic conduct rules and displays courteous interaction.
level_2_description: Demonstrates ethical consistency in routine transactions and handles citizen complaints with empathy.
level_3_description: Proactively addresses integrity risks, ensures transparency in public dealings, and champions citizen-centric service design.
level_4_description: Mentors teams on ethical dilemmas, strengthens anti-corruption safeguards, and enhances institutional accountability.
level_5_description: Serves as an exemplar of public service ethos and influences national administrative ethics policies.

description: Skill in precise noting, cabinet memo drafting, parliamentary question response, inter-ministerial consultation, and citizen communication.
level_1_description: Drafts simple letters, memos, and routine file notes using standard templates.
level_2_description: Prepares clear noting, summarizes precedents, and drafts comprehensive office memorandums.
level_3_description: Drafts high-level policy briefs, parliamentary replies, cabinet notes, and addresses legal subtleties.
level_4_description: Articulates complex public policy positions persuasively to ministers, parliamentary committees, and media.
level_5_description: Authors landmark policy white papers and leads international bilateral communication on behalf of the ministry.

description: Understanding digital platforms (e-Office, GeM, Aadhaar, DigiLocker, CPGRAMS), cybersecurity hygiene, and data-driven decision making.
level_1_description: Operates basic office productivity tools and standard portals like e-Office.
level_2_description: Leverages government digital platforms, dashboards, and ensures standard cyber hygiene.
level_3_description: Utilizes data analytics for monitoring schemes, integrates API-based digital services, and applies data privacy norms.
level_4_description: Architects departmental digital transformation roadmaps and manages AI/digital system lifecycles.
level_5_description: Drives national digital infrastructure strategies and shapes cross-sector data governance policies.

description: Mastery of General Financial Rules (GFR 2017), GeM procurement guidelines, tender preparation, contract management, and audit compliance.
level_1_description: Knows basic purchasing procedures and direct GeM purchases within small thresholds.
level_2_description: Executes standard procurement via L1 bidding, handles bid evaluations, and verifies invoices against GFR.
level_3_description: Designs QCBS tenders, manages complex vendor contracts, guarantees audit compliance, and resolves billing disputes.
level_4_description: Oversees major departmental budget allocations, high-value global tenders, and public-private partnerships (PPP).
level_5_description: Formulates public procurement reforms, fiscal rule revisions, and financial accountability frameworks.

description: Capacity to understand citizen expectations, implement Citizen Charters, promptly resolve grievances via CPGRAMS, and continuously improve service delivery.
level_1_description: Receives and registers citizen grievances in the designated portal.
level_2_description: Investigates grievance root causes and coordinates timely replies within SLA.
level_3_description: Identifies recurring grievance trends and recommends operational improvements in public service workflows.
level_4_description: Redesigns end-to-end service delivery channels for seamless omnichannel citizen satisfaction.
level_5_description: Establishes institutional accountability models and national grievance redressal quality benchmarks.
